//LiveKit: ApiKey and ApiSecret are REQUIRED and deliberately blank. They used to carry LiveKit's
published development defaults, which meant a service started without them signed join
tokens with a secret that is in this repository and in LiveKit's own documentation — and a
join token is entry to the media room, not a step towards it. Compose supplies both with
`:?`; a bare `dotnet run` without them now fails at startup naming the key.
//ClassroomService: Asked whether a user belongs to a classroom, before this service mints a LiveKit join token
(test-plan G-02). This service holds no roster, and the token IS entry to the media room.
The client fails CLOSED: an unreachable ClassroomService refuses new joins rather than
admitting everybody. TimeoutSeconds is shorter than LiveAssistant's on purpose — a person is
waiting on this one, and a timeout is a refusal they can retry by pressing the button again.

//CustomBaseUrl: Set per environment, NOT here. Blank means LiveKit's built-in template, which is what this
recorded before the option existed — and is the safe default, because taking over the
template means a mistake in it surfaces after the lesson rather than during it.

Like S3:Endpoint, this URL is resolved by the host-networked egress worker, so a service
name that works for this service will not work there. The effective value is reported by

//Endpoint: Set per environment, NOT here. This endpoint is used by the livekit-egress worker, which
runs on HOST networking — a bridge-network service name like http://intellilect-s3:9000
resolves for this service but never for the uploader, so recordings encode fine and then
fail silently at upload. Compose supplies MinIO's host-published address instead.
Blank = default AWS S3. The effective value is reported by the egress health check.

//Media: LiveKit CLIENT settings, sent to the browser with the join token. See MediaOptions.cs for why
each value is what it is — three of them must not be changed without reading the reasons.
DO NOT CHANGE: Dtx and StopMicTrackOnMute feed the AI assistant's audio frame stream and its
pause detection. Simulcast is what AdaptiveStream selects from.
DEFERRED: AudioPreset -> 'speech' only after STT is verified (an SFU forwards this exact audio
to the transcriber). VideoCodec -> 'h264' only after testing Firefox/Safari simulcast.
The LIVE stream is where the resolution budget is spent (1080p capture, 3 Mbps share) and the
Egress section is deliberately held DOWN at 960x540 to pay for it — the room judges the stream
in real time, the recording is watched later from a file. Read both together before raising
either: on one host they compete for the same encoder headroom.
